title: The Adopted Mine
logline: A close-knit crew of laborers inherited a lucrative asteroid claim, but a massive corporation is using forged safety violations to force them out.

roles.description: Fiercely protective of their crew, refusing to back down.
Smug, heavily bribed, looks for excuses to shut things down.
A dense, high-yield ferrite asteroid covered in makeshift rigging.
An unmarked security vessel used for corporate strong-arming.
A weak union that talks big but rarely fights the corps.
A neutral orbital court in a neighboring system.

public_situation: The {role:mining_guild} has ordered the independent {role:mining_claim} to halt operations due to a sudden influx of safety violations.
private_truth: The violations are fabricated by the inspector to bankrupt the crew so a massive corporation can buy the claim for pennies.

beats.public_change: The inspector impounds the crew's ore shipments, cutting off their income.

missions.reason: The foreman needs the pilot to blow open a corporate security ship to steal back their impounded sensor logs.
missions.private_fact: The logs will prove the structural integrity of the mine is perfectly sound.

beats.public_change: The corporation officially files to repossess the claim.

missions.reason: The pilot must scan the mine's support struts to independently verify the logs.
missions.private_fact: The scan will flag the pilot as an active participant in an illegal labor dispute.

beats.public_change: The local authorities refuse to look at the evidence. The foreman calls for an injunction from a higher court.

missions.reason: The pilot must jump to the neighboring system and deliver the evidence to the distant court before the repossession deadline.
missions.private_fact: The corporation has locked down the gate, making the journey highly dangerous.

beats.public_change: Corporate hit squads intercept the pilot at the court.

missions.reason: The pilot must destroy the corporate assassins trying to prevent them from filing the injunction.
missions.private_fact: The assassins have orders to destroy the courthouse itself if necessary.

beats.public_change: The injunction is filed, but the inspector makes one last desperate attempt to stop the proceedings.

missions.reason: The pilot must destroy the inspector's personal enforcer ship before it escapes back to their jurisdiction.
missions.private_fact: The inspector hails the pilot, offering a massive bribe to drop the case and delete the logs.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot destroys the inspector and files the evidence.
resolutions.summary: The court rules in the crew's favor. The corporation is fined heavily, and the crew's claim is permanently secured.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot dragged a corrupt inspector to court and saved a crew of rock-hoppers from being swallowed by the corps.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the inspector's bribe.
resolutions.summary: The evidence is 'lost'. The corporation seizes the mine, and the crew is fired without severance.
The deadline passes. Corporate security storms the mine, killing several workers and evicting the rest.

loose_threads.detail: The inspector's bribe money was wired from a shell company that officially builds agricultural equipment.
The corporate assassins flew ships bearing the insignia of a disbanded planetary defense force.

radio_hooks: Independent miners file massive lawsuit against corporate regulators.
Violence reported near {role:distant_court} following mining dispute.

voice_direction.crew_foreman: Tired, gruff, speaks to the pilot like a trusted sibling.
voice_direction.corporate_inspector: Sneering, arrogant, constantly reminding people of their authority.
